title: Marupes NSS demolish Valmiera to take LJBL U19 Boys crown as fourth seeds
description: Fourth-seeded Marupes NSS pulled off the upset of the Swedbank LJBL U19 Boys finals on Sunday, overwhelming second-seeded Bertanu Valmieras BS 93-76 behind a devastating team effort that featured four players scoring 19 or more points. Coach Davis Coders' side trailed 16-19 after the first quarter but seized control from the second period onward, outscoring Valmiera 31-19 in the second quarter to take a 47-38 halftime lead and never looking back.
imageCaption: Marupes NSS demolish Valmiera to take LJBL U19 Boys crown as fourth seeds-May 10, 2026
